description: Claim a Goal for this Session, so only this Session works on it. The Session keeps any other Goals it holds; while it holds several, pass goal to the tools that change one. Fails if another running Session holds it. Claiming a done Goal reopens it: its finished Tasks stay done, and add_tasks adds the new work to the same list.

takeover.description: Take the Goal from another running Session. Only when the Developer asks for it.

name: claim_goal
title: Claim Goal
